package.description: A terminal coding agent, written in Rust.

en-US.description: A terminal coding agent, written in Rust.
en-US.longDescription:
Zevria is a terminal coding agent written in Rust. It can investigate a codebase, prepare a plan for approval, edit files, run commands, and delegate independent work—all from an interactive terminal UI. It also runs as a headless Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent for editors and other clients.
Highlights
- Collaborative Plan writing: /ensemble-plan <prompt> gathers independent proposals from configured ACP agents—including Claude Code and Codex in the default setup—and synthesizes a Plan after you review and confirm the proposals. Workers must be installed and authenticated.
- Vim-style transcript navigation: switch between Normal and Insert modes, move quickly through messages, copy message or tool content, and fold or unfold transcript items and turns with familiar Vim-inspired controls.
en-US.name: Zevria
en-US.releaseNotes:
Highlights
- Fix spurious configuration-busy errors by explicitly releasing settings locks when transactions finish, even while duplicated handles remain open.
- Allow composer feedback to revise a dismissed Ready Plan.
- Improve transcript styling and hide RTK routing in command displays while preserving exact copied commands.
- Center the desktop session column and clear focus when clicking blank space.
- Consolidate maintainer documentation and remove unused assets.
GitHub Actions passed the Linux, macOS, and Windows checks, native package and installer smoke tests, provider-prefix gates, and checksum assembly.
Source commit: 3f4d92acde97a89584349129c2e66544ddc17e62
Full Changelog: https://github.com/liukaizheng/zevria/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1

zh-CN.description: 用 Rust 编写的终端编程智能体。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Zevria 是一个用 Rust 编写的终端编程智能体。它在交互式终端界面中检查代码库、准备待审批的计划、编辑文件、运行命令，并委派彼此独立的工作；也可以作为无头的 Agent Client Protocol（ACP）智能体，供编辑器和其他客户端使用。
亮点包括协作编写计划（/ensemble-plan 收集 Claude Code、Codex 等已配置 ACP 智能体各自独立提出的方案，经审阅确认后综合成一份计划）以及 Vim 风格的对话导航。Zevria 需要单独安装 ripgrep、RTK，Windows 上还需要 Git for Windows；本包已将其中可通过 winget 安装的部分声明为依赖。
